originality.rationale: The previously published 3-e.c. threshold q>=29 implies only the upper equivalence class. It does not itself classify five lower q values at rank four nor distinguish the two pairs of matching induced-four-vertex ages. Explicit low-order alternating-quantifier witnesses complete that distinct claim. The accessible 2005 and 2010 full texts concern different classification targets; earlier directly relevant 1981 and 1993 full texts remained inaccessible and are recorded as risks, not asserted NOT_COVERING.
residual_risks: Directly relevant 1993 Paley-adjacency primary full text was inaccessible; it could contain small-order tables or equivalent distinctions.
The 1981 logic-adjacency article full text was also inaccessible; only its abstract and indirect citations were available.
Unindexed finite-model-theory results or databases might independently imply this exact six-class partition.
The q>=29 three-extension threshold is known and is not an originality component.
